en: Reverted the 2.1.282 reservation of the `claude-ai` name: skills, commands, workflows and MCP servers' skills and prompts so named load again, and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` rules are ordinary prefix rules
zh: 撤销 2.1.282 对 `claude-ai` 名称的保留：以此命名的 skill、命令、工作流以及 MCP 服务器的 skill 和 prompt 重新可以加载，`Skill(claude-ai:*)` 规则恢复为普通前缀规则
